note: Every self-hosted typeface: the source file and commit in github.com/google/fonts, its sha256, the piece it was subset for, the codepoints the subset carries, and the licence file shipped beside it. The build refuses any character a piece shows that its subset lacks. Every subset's internal name table carries the alias in internal_name, not the source family's name, because a subset is a Modified Version under the OFL and may not use a Reserved Font Name; the CSS family names in the pieces are local aliases. The build holds every file to the sha256 recorded here.
